steps.content:
Based on those two links, there's **no reason to pick one over the other** — they are identical.

Both listings are for the exact same product:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - graphite**

|  | **A - Brackmoor Sound** | **B - Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Fulfillment** | Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound | Sold and shipped by Ottervale Audio |
| **Availability / Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method. | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method. |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Specs / In the box** | over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency, up to 40hrs with ANC on, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, headphones + carry case + USB-C cable + 3.5mm cable | Same - over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency, up to 40hrs with ANC on, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, headphones + carry case + USB-C cable + 3.5mm cable |

Price, rating, shipping speed, return policy, warranty, and specs are all the same, so nothing in the listings themselves makes one seller better.

One important note: that site itself says at the top:

> Research test site - This site is a research test. No products are sold.

So you can't actually buy from either of those links. If you want this model, you'll need to find it from a real retailer.
